text: A Python list is an ordered, changeable collection. Use append() to add one item to the end of a list.
A Python dictionary stores data as key and value pairs. Access a value by writing the key inside square brackets.
Use a for loop to repeat code for every item in a list, string, or other iterable object.
A function is reusable code defined with the def keyword. Functions can accept parameters and return a result.
Use try and except to handle errors without stopping the whole Python program.
The json module converts Python dictionaries and lists to JSON text with json.dumps(), and reads JSON text with json.loads().
Use the open function or pathlib Path to read from and write to files. Use read_text() to read a text file.
A Python class is created with the class keyword. An object is an instance of a class and can contain data and methods.
Use pip install followed by a package name to install a Python library, for example pip install sentence-transformers.
